early_learning_goals.title: Self-Regulation
early_learning_goals.description: Shows an understanding of own feelings, regulates behaviour accordingly, sets and works towards simple goals, waits for what they want, controls immediate impulses when appropriate

early_learning_goals.title: Managing Self
early_learning_goals.description: Manages own basic hygiene and personal needs, is confident to try new activities, explains why rules are important, manages own feelings and behaviour

early_learning_goals.title: Building Relationships
early_learning_goals.description: Works and plays cooperatively, forms positive relationships with adults and peers, shows sensitivity to others' needs and feelings

early_learning_goals.title: Listening, Attention and Understanding
early_learning_goals.description: Listens attentively, responds appropriately, follows instructions with several steps, answers 'how' and 'why' questions

early_learning_goals.title: Speaking
early_learning_goals.description: Expresses ideas using full sentences, uses new vocabulary, retells narratives, offers explanations for why things happen

early_learning_goals.title: Gross Motor Skills
early_learning_goals.description: Negotiates space and obstacles safely, demonstrates strength/balance/coordination, moves confidently in a range of ways

early_learning_goals.title: Fine Motor Skills
early_learning_goals.description: Holds a pencil effectively, uses a range of small tools, shows good control when writing/drawing

early_learning_goals.title: Comprehension
early_learning_goals.description: Demonstrates understanding of stories through discussion, anticipates key events, uses new vocabulary in different contexts

early_learning_goals.title: Word Reading
early_learning_goals.description: Says sounds for graphemes, reads simple sentences and phonically decodable words accurately

early_learning_goals.title: Writing
early_learning_goals.description: Writes recognisable letters, spells words by identifying sounds, writes simple phrases/sentences that can be read by others

early_learning_goals.title: Number
early_learning_goals.description: Counts reliably to 20, recalls number bonds to 5 (and some to 10), subitises small quantities

early_learning_goals.title: Numerical Patterns
early_learning_goals.description: Compares quantities, explores odd/even, doubling and sharing, continues/creates patterns

early_learning_goals.title: Past and Present
early_learning_goals.description: Talks about past/present events in own life and family, compares characters from stories

early_learning_goals.title: People, Culture and Communities
early_learning_goals.description: Describes own immediate environment, knows some similarities/differences between communities and traditions

early_learning_goals.title: The Natural World
early_learning_goals.description: Explores the natural world, makes observations of plants/animals, understands seasonal change

early_learning_goals.title: Creating with Materials
early_learning_goals.description: Safely uses tools/materials, joins materials, shares creations, uses colour purposefully

early_learning_goals.title: Being Imaginative and Expressive
early_learning_goals.description: Invents/adapts songs, performs songs/rhymes/stories, plays imaginatively with role-play and small-world
